cases.sentence: – Дай же отряхнуться, папаша, – говорил несколько сиплым от дороги, но звонким ___ Аркадий, весело отвечая на отцовские ласки, – я тебя всего запачкаю.
cases.explain: «юношеским голосом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: "Yes, but first give me a rub down, dearest Papa," said Arkady in a voice which, though a little hoarsened with travelling, was yet clear and youthful. "See! I am covering you with dust!" he added as joyously he returned his father's caresses.

cases.sentence: – Папаша, – сказал он, – позволь познакомить тебя с моим ___, Базаровым, о котором я тебе так часто писал.
cases.explain: «добрым приятелем» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: "Papa," he said, "first let me introduce my good friend Bazarov, who is the comrade whom I have so often mentioned in letters to you, and who has been kind enough to come to us for a visit."

cases.sentence: Николай Петрович быстро обернулся и, подойдя к человеку ___, в длинном балахоне с кистями, только что вылезшему из тарантаса, крепко стиснул его обнаженную красную руку, которую тот не сразу ему подал.
cases.explain: «высокого роста» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: At once Nikolai Petrovitch wheeled round, and, approaching a tall man who, clad in a long coat with a tasselled belt, had just alighted from the tarantass, pressed the bare red hand which, after a pause, the stranger offered him.

cases.sentence: – Евгений Васильев, – отвечал Базаров ленивым, но ___ и, отвернув воротник балахона, показал Николаю Петровичу все свое лицо.
cases.explain: «мужественным голосом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: "Evgenii Vasiliev," replied the other in slow, but virile, accents as, turning down the collar of his coat, he revealed his face more clearly. Long and thin, with a high forehead which looked flattened at the top and became sharpened towards the nose, the face had large, greenish eyes and long, sandy whiskers. The instant that the features brightened into a smile, however, they betokened self-assurance and intellect.

cases.sentence: ___ Базарова чуть тронулись; но он ничего не отвечал и только приподнял фуражку.
cases.explain: «Тонкие губы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Bazarov gave his lips a slight twitch, but vouchsafed no reply beyond raising his cap—a movement which revealed the fact that the prominent convolutions of the skull were by no means concealed by the superincumbent mass of indeterminate-coloured hair.

cases.sentence: – Слышь, Митюха, – подхватил другой, тут же стоявший ямщик с руками, засунутыми в ___ тулупа, – барин-то тебя как прозвал?
cases.explain: «задние прорехи» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: "Come, bestir yourself, fat-beard!" "Did you hear that, Mitiusha?" added another ostler who was standing with his hands thrust into the back slits of his blouse. "The barin has just called you a fat-beard. And a fat-beard you are."
